test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Bhavai is a dance form that belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhavai is the dance form associated with** Rajasthan**.
 
• It is associated with the **Bhavai community**.
 
• Bhavai is a **storytelling** dance of themes from **Hindu Mythology**, **social issues**, and **everyday life**.
 
• The main instruments used are **Dholak, Flute, and Sarangi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 State
 Dances
 
 

 Rajasthan
 Ghoomar, Chari, Ginad, Jhulan Leela, Kalbeliya, Bhavai, Kachchhi Ghodi.
 
 

 Bihar
 Bidesia Dance, Jat-Jatin Dance, Lori Dance, Nautanki Dance.
 
 

 Madhya pradesh
 Karma, Saila-Reena, Goncho, Bhagoriya, Chatkora, Thapti, Lehangi, Lota Dance.
 
 

 Odisha 
 Ghumura Dance, Sambalpuri Dance, Chaiti Ghoda Dance, Ranappa Dance, Gotipua Dance
